During the youth of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], there was a [[Sikurdian/Legends|Sikurdian]] [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Padawan]] who was rejected from further [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]] by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]. In a fit of rage the Padawan began to attack any [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] he could within the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], wounding and nearly killing the famed Jedi Master [[Tera Sinube/Legends|Tera Sinube]].<ref name="SkyeWalkers" />
